text:
maria: FYI noticed an odd cascade of cordons in us-west-2 around 03:10 UTC — several K8s nodes and a few Slurm compute nodes quarantined in quick succession. CPU fine, GPUs showing ECC/Xid bursts.
ajay: Ugh. Did the healthhook thresholds change?
sophia: Nope, thresholds unchanged. Telemetry shows short spike (ECC count ~4) per node within 2m window. Our current rule immediately cordons when ECC>3 in 5m.
maria: Right — that aggressive threshold worked for single-card failures but last night it tripped on a transient power-surge in rack 12. We ended up losing ~12 GPUs across services for ~20m while replacements rolled.
jen: Can we add a regional dampening/cluster hysteresis? We should avoid triggering >N cordons in same AZ within X minutes.
ajay: We have `soft_quarantine` in prod but it's per-node only. Proposal: add a cluster-level suppressor: if >=3 nodes in same AZ report ECC spike within 10m, delay further auto-evac by 15m and route alerts to ops-oncall for manual triage.
sophia: Also need Slurm semantics — draining a Slurm node differs: we should `scontrol requeue` vs immediate kill. For Slurm, only cordon if pending jobs can be rescheduled or if ECC persists after two probes.
maria: Agreed. Drafted a config snippet for the new policy:

```yaml
policy_name: auto-evacuation-v2
conditions:
  - metric: gpu_ecc_spike_count
    window: 10m
    threshold: 5
  - metric: gpu_xid_rate
    window: 1m
    threshold: 200
suppressions:
  - scope: az
    max_triggers: 2
    cooldown: 15m
actions:
  - type: cordon
    target: kubernetes
    annotation_skip: redwood.com/critical-workload: "true"
  - type: notify
    target: ops-oncall
  - type: slurm_probe
    retries: 2
    requeue_policy: graceful
```

ajay: Nice. Two small asks: 1) make the thresholds config per-hardware-family (A100 vs H100) and 2) add a KV cache check so long-running cached prefixes aren't invalidated by temporary node removal.
sophia: For (1) we tag nodes with `hw.family: a100/h100` and the engine picks quantization-aware thresholds. For (2) we already have `prefix_cache_replicas: 2` but need a flag to prefer warm-cache nodes during rebalancing.
jen: Operationally, we should also add an allowlist for a small set of hosts that never auto-evacuate (eg. infra-critical viz nodes) — implemented via the `annotation_skip` above.
ops-oncall: If we flip this policy on, what's the expected alert volume? Last time the suppressor wasn't in place and we woke up the whole oncall.
maria: With suppression and hw-family tuned thresholds, forecast is <3 high-severity alerts/week, mostly during maintenance windows. We'll add rate-limited paging.
drain-bot: event: 1958004418 - gpu-ecc-spike detected on node gpu-usw2-13 (count: 6) -> trial_probe scheduled
sophia: Also adding a two-stage probe: (1) remote memtest quick pass, (2) stress-infer for 30s on isolated workload. Only cordon if probe fails or ECC persists.
ajay: We should add a safety that avoids mass rebalancing during peak autoscaler activity — if autoscaler_activity > 0.7, delay non-critical cordons.
jen: Can someone write the rollout plan? I'd prefer a gradual rollout: start in staging -> one prod AZ -> full prod; include a fail-open where old behavior returns if new policy errors.
maria: I'll PR today. Rollout plan in PR description will be: staging (48h) -> prod-us-west-2a (72h) -> prod-wide. Health metrics to watch: cordons/min, pod_evictions, slurm_requeues, cache_miss_rate.
sophia: Testcases: simulated ECC storms (3 nodes), single node flake, Slurm long-job protected by `redwood.com/critical-workload=true`.
ajay: I can add the probe scripts and a dry-run mode to the controller so it reports but doesn't act.
ops-oncall: Please also add an automatic incident ticket if suppression trips 2x in 24h for same AZ (makes triage easier).
maria: Good call — I'll add that to PR. Anything blocking?
jen: thumbs up from me. Let's make sure docs in eng-runbooks updated and runbook links in alert messages.
sophia: I'll draft the runbook section for Slurm-specific steps.
maria: OK launching a WIP PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/infra/auto-evac-v2/pull/42 — please review. I'll switch to `enforced` after staging smoke passes. :rocket:
